page.overview:
What is No-Option River?

The No-Option River is a large and treacherous river which emits a foul smell. Many damned souls float in the river eternally.

Damned spirits cross the river by ferry. Others take the bridge, with is miles long but only three spans wide, with no handrails. There are two other bridges: a silver bridge reserved for people of great rectitude, and a gold bridge reserved for virtuous rulers.
